input_root: Operator supplies the existing neutral_inputs root; every path below is relative to it.
blind_protocol: Give each reader only this spec, these unchanged full-page images and their neutral input bindings. Do not provide code, tests, form rules, prior outputs, research calculations, comparison reports or expected answers.

Use two different normalized model families with distinct reader_id values. Run isolated sessions; neither sees another output before both immutable raw files are retained and hashed. Use the same two families for income and note pages.

Read directly from the page image. Preserve literal text, printed codes, case, accents, Roman prefixes, numbers, punctuation, signs and uncertainty. Never infer from accounting arithmetic, another period, AGM percentages or a restated comparative.

Output one independent_image_reading/v1 JSON object per image per reader (ten new raw records for the five pages). Keep all numeric columns, comparative/restated labels and note references as read. Do not turn dashes or blanks into zero.

Use deterministic column_id values c1, c2, ... in left-to-right table-column order in both sessions; repeat them in cells. Semantic role current applies ONLY to the original current-period amount column. Keep comparative, restated and note_reference roles distinct; never use current_period as the current role.

Use explicit actual timezone-aware recorded_at at completion of each reading; no null, guessed time, backdating or substitution of file/seal time. Model family is a supported alias, not a version or product label.

Retain each raw file byte-identically and record its actual aware retained_at and SHA256 before any comparison. A seal may record retention but cannot supply missing raw recorded_at. Existing cold records remain immutable and ineligible; do not convert them.
Read printed_page from the image, never from the PDF index or filename. Missing/unreadable prerequisites stay unproven; do not copy the manifest placeholder into a purported eligible binding.

raw_record_schema.model_family: One of openai-gpt / openai-chatgpt / gpt / codex (gpt); google-gemini / gemini (gemini); anthropic-claude / claude (claude). Different aliases of one family count as one.
raw_record_schema.reader_id: Nonempty actual reader/session identifier, distinct from the other reader.
raw_record_schema.recorded_at: Actual ISO8601 instant with timezone offset, explicitly recorded by the reader workflow.

input.document_sha256: Exact bound PDF SHA256 from pages.
input.document_id: Exact bound retained document ID from pages.
input.image_sha256: Exact SHA256 of the unchanged supplied image.
input.source_page: Integer one-based physical PDF page from pages.
input.printed_page: Literal printed page identity independently read from image.

table.scope_literal: Read explicit scope from image; never infer consolidated from another page.
table.form_reference_literal: Read printed form reference from image; never invent a template.
table.currency_unit_literal: Read explicit currency/scale declaration from image.

columns[].label_literal: Full printed header, including any restatement marking.
columns[].reporting_period: null when the column is caption-bound; otherwise its exact printed period literal. Do not invent FY/6M labels.
columns[].role: current only for the explicit original current column; comparative/restated/note_reference otherwise.

rows[].line_code_literal: Printed code as a string; null if unnumbered, never invented.

cells[].raw_value_literal: Literal digits/grouping or dash/blank as read; no numeric repair.
cells[].sign_literal: unsigned or parentheses for a readable numeric cell; preserve unresolved signs as uncertainty.
cells[].uncertainty: List of actual uncertainties; [] only if none. Never clear uncertainty for eligibility.

prose_observations[].quote_literal: For the two note pages: exact earnings-allocation/fund-appropriation disclosure text read independently; no interpretation.
prose_observations[].uncertainty: List of actual uncertainties; [] only if none.

postreading_operator_requirements: Do not send this section as evidence of an answer. Operator must retain exact same-PDF/image/source bindings and manifest-selected rights_route OWNER_APPROVED_OFFICIAL_ISSUER_RESEARCH_NOT_VIETSTOCK, acquisition_route INDEPENDENT_OFFICIAL_SOURCE, rights_status RESEARCH_AND_AI_READING_APPROVED, issuer_name and page_image_bindings.

Only after both raw records are retained, create the existing dual_reader_reviewed_transcription/v1 agreement proof with document ID/SHA, page_image, two {relative_path, sha256, retained_at} readings, actual comparison_started_at and admission_completed_at. All referenced files must remain beneath landing/dual-reader-transcriptions/.

Chronology: source observed_at <= raw recorded_at <= raw retained_at < comparison_started_at <= admission_completed_at. knowledge_available_at is no earlier than completion or either recording. Apply the requested cutoff.

For income code 201 only, attach appropriation_note = {page_image, readings} for the corresponding same-PDF note page, using both income families and actual chronology. The verifier must establish literal disclosure and identical current numerator; a caller basis claim alone cannot qualify.
Qualified metadata, legal issuer/scope, audited/reviewed assurance, source and use gates remain separate prerequisites. These five images do not supply missing cover/assurance evidence.

No registered basis note is supplied here for original H1/2025; that code 201 basis and the three-operand TTM remain blocked pending separately qualified evidence. Comparative/restated H1/2025 is not a replacement. Notes classify basis only; no EPS/share-count or note-fact admission.

Run the real retained common admission only after native lane, review and capacity corrective gates. Research tier only; no config activation, source promotion, Production, Daily, PIT or execution authority follows from readings or numerical agreement.
